description: This Java class 'JobManager' manages scheduling, polling, and execution of jobs within the OFBiz framework. It handles job queuing, scheduling with recurrence, job polling, and crash recovery, interacting with entities like JobSandbox and JobManagerLock.

classes.name: JobManager
classes.description: Manages job scheduling, polling, execution, and recovery within the OFBiz framework, supporting recurring jobs, crash recovery, and job queue management.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of JobManager for a given delegator, optionally enabling the poller.

methods.name: shutDown
methods.description: Shuts down all JobManager instances and stops the poller, typically called during system shutdown.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Returns the Delegator associated with this JobManager.

methods.name: getDispatcher
methods.description: Returns the LocalDispatcher for service invocation.

methods.name: getPoolState
methods.description: Returns the current state of job processing threads.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the JobManager can run jobs, based on lock conditions.

methods.name: poll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of jobs due to run, handling transaction management and job claiming.

methods.name: getJobsToPurge
methods.description: Retrieves jobs eligible for purging based on completion or cancellation time.

methods.name: reloadCrashedJobs
methods.description: Re-schedules jobs that crashed or are stuck in pending/running states.

methods.name: runJob
methods.description: Queues a specific Job instance for immediate execution.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules a new job with specified service, timing, recurrence, and retry parameters.
